newsitem.title: USA: Bolero Investment ups Baldwin Piano stake.
newsitem.headline: Bolero Investment ups Baldwin Piano stake.

text.p: Bolero Investment Group LP said it has increased its stake in Baldwin Piano and Organ Co to 8.2 percent.
Bolero general partner Kenneth Pavia Sr said the additional shares were acquired as an investment which he views as having significant potential for increased value.

In October, Bolero urged Baldwin to hire an investment banker to explore the possible sale, merger, or business combination as a method of enhancing the company's value. Bolero also said it plans to propose five nominees to stand for election as members of Baldwin's board of directors. The nominees are to be offered at Baldwin's 1997 annual shareholders' meeting, Bolero has said.
